title: Among gas stations in the Czech Republic that had any transaction on or aft
question: Among gas stations in the Czech Republic that had any transaction on or after January 1, 2012, what percentage belong to the 'Premium' segment? Separately, for SME-segment customers who paid in CZK and made at least one morning transaction (before 13:00) on or after January 1, 2012, what was their average monthly consumption in 2013?

prediction.sql:
WITH cze_stations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT gs."XCL_004" AS station_id, gs."XCL_007" AS segment
    FROM gasstations AS gs
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON gs."XCL_004" = t."XCL_015"
    WHERE gs."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
      AND t."XCL_011" >= '2012-01-01'
),
qualified_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_001" AS customer_id
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
    WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'SME'
      AND c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND t."XCL_011" >= '2012-01-01'
      AND t."XCL_012" < '13:00:00'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(segment = 'Premium', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(station_id)
     FROM cze_stations) AS premium_percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(ym."XCL_021")
     FROM qualified_customers AS qc
     INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON qc."customer_id" = ym."XCL_019"
     WHERE ym."XCL_020" BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312') AS avg_monthly_consumption_2013

WITH cze_stations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT gs."XCL_004" AS station_id, gs."XCL_007" AS segment
    FROM gasstations AS gs
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON gs."XCL_004" = t."XCL_015"
    WHERE gs."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
      AND t."XCL_011" >= '2012-01-01'
),
qualified_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_001" AS customer_id
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
    WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'SME'
      AND c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND t."XCL_011" >= '2012-01-01'
      AND t."XCL_012" < '13:00:00'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(segment = 'Premium', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(station_id)
     FROM cze_stations) AS premium_percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(ym."XCL_021")
     FROM qualified_customers AS qc
     INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON qc."customer_id" = ym."XCL_019"
     WHERE ym."XCL_020" BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312') AS avg_monthly_consumption_2013

WITH qualified_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_001" AS customer_id
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
    WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'SME'
      AND c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND t."XCL_011" >= '2012-01-01'
      AND t."XCL_012" < '13:00:00'
)
SELECT AVG(ym."XCL_021") / 12
FROM qualified_customers qc
